support_protocol.description: Canonical voltage clamp histories: alternating long hyperpolarization/recovery and brief repeated depolarizing bursts, randomized durations/amplitudes. No fresh evaluation traces are used to manufacture targets.

objective: Same52f long-credit data, batches,800updates and original unpenalized validation/selection. Factorial2x2: training-only per-channel regression penalty x current-priority projection of conflicting trajectory gradient. All12models share512tick forward/BPTT. Frozen encoders and same10logical states; no calibration warmup.
selection: Same52e guard against original52d trajectory before recalibration: everychannel currentMSE andseparateV/Ca developmentMSE nonincreasing within1e-6relative+1e-12absolute. Same baseline fallback andshared full validation objective. Eight preregistered checkpoints. No fresh selection.

cost.scope: Same three-seed atomic update andreadout; not whole neuron.

diagnostics: Per-checkpoint original channel/V/Ca guards; gradient conflict frequency/cosine before-after, penalty activation perchannel, gradient norms, matched control. Early andlate budgets fromsame trajectory. No final evaluation of rejected checkpoints and no promotion by mean loss.
limitations: Exploratory reused52panel, not independent confirmation. Both interventions are training-only heuristics, not guarantees. No new state dimensions, inputs or analytic online gates. Adam may still regress despite first-order projection. Same inference architecture; timing differences among identical selected fallback models are not architecture speedups. Cap52j; no automaticTask53.
user_cap: Last allowed subtask52j; no52k. Any subsequent53transition retains unresolved quality limits.

preservation.reference: Frozen original52d trajectory, same fit windows and initial conditions; training-only reference, never an inference component.
preservation.formula: mean_channels relu((block_MSE-current_reference_block_MSE)/clamp(reference_block_MSE,1e-6)); block is128ticks and batch-averaged. No penalty for improving a channel.

projection.priority: current-objective gradient, including guard when enabled
projection.formula: For each independent seed/model: if dot(gc,gv)<0, gv <- gv-dot(gc,gv)/norm(gc)^2*gc; use gc+gv before the original per-model gradient clip and Adam.
projection.limitation: Euclidean first-order gradient protection is not a guarantee for finite Adam steps, individual channels, or autonomous rollouts. Test those explicitly.
